long_biography.plain_text:
The Los Angeles LGBT Center's Anita May Rosenstein Campus converts a major philanthropic commitment into housing, education and services for LGBTQ+ youth and older adults. Its intergenerational model places youth housing, senior programmes and the Center's administration on one site. The complex gives Rosenstein's longstanding support a permanent institutional form.

Rosenstein has also backed projects with clearly defined local outcomes. A partnership with Anne and Kirk Douglas helped improve recreation spaces at four hundred Los Angeles public schools. Lambda Legal used her matching grant to broaden donor support for its Washington office, while the family's National Jewish Health giving continues across another generation.
